decisions.reason: It reinforces the firm's core second-channel authentication and secure communication proposition, so a medium-sized German security specialist would usually keep it on the market beyond its first year.
Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's stated move toward app-based interactions and online contract signing, making early discontinuation unlikely.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly aligned with the firm's cryptography-led platform business and should remain strategically important.
It extends the firm's secure messaging ecosystem, although as a more specific delivery tool it has a somewhat higher risk of later being absorbed into broader offerings.

A QR-code hardware token is less in line with the firm's forward direction toward app-based, cross-channel identity and adds hardware complexity, so management would be comparatively more willing to withdraw it.
Compliance-focused payment security is attractive in regulated enterprise markets and leverages the firm's established authentication and security infrastructure.
